newsitem.title: USA: Duke trims 1,129 MW Catawba 1 output - NRC.
newsitem.headline: Duke trims 1,129 MW Catawba 1 output - NRC.

text.p: Duke Power Co trimmed the output of the 1,129 megawatt (MW) Catawba 1 nuclear unit in Clover, S.C., due to main transformer oil leak, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was running at 48 percent of capacity, NRC said its Monday status report. Catawba 1 was operating at full power, according to Friday's report.
The neigboring Catawba unit 2 was producing electricity at 100 percent of its 1,129 MW capacity.
Duke operates both Catawba units, and owns 25 percent of Catawba 1.
Duke officials were not immediately available for comment.
